note: OCT30-INFRA-S015: signing, verification and separate (never Latest) publication of one retained, already-compiled Rango (Pixel 10 Pro Fold) build by scripts/rango-retained.py, reusing the Frankel primitives (host-sign.py, host_secrets.py, release-pipeline.py checks, github_release_publisher.py). No compile, app rebuild, key generation or bootstrap. Every null below is an unbound real input: the route refuses before any controller, login or secret access while any is null. Values are never copied from Frankel or guessed.

input.transportBasis: Unbound: no supported transport moves the Mac operator's retained outputs to the original builder. When bound it is {"kind": ..., "directory": absolute builder path}: a directory holding exactly the receipt, target-files, otatools, resolved manifest and background policy, staged into a fresh task-owned consumer directory and revalidated before secrets.

signing.bootstrapReceiptBasis: Unbound: the public receipt (inline JSON) of a genuine completed fold-rango-v1 bootstrap names the committed secret versions and the OTA certificate and AVB public key identities. No bootstrap has run.
signing.provenanceBasis: Unbound: executable otatools and the release script need an approved source binding (pinned revision and content hashes), not only the artifact's self-reported hashes.
signing.sourceBasis: The original builder tree and the shared global lock of os/build-only/rango.json and os/release-pipeline/frankel.json.

identityPolicy.modeBasis: OCT30-INFRA-S017: the selected initial identity authority is the genuine fold-rango-v1 bootstrap public receipt (signing.bootstrapReceipt, still unbound: artifact 12961047183 is held and is never retrieved by another route).

firstUse.basis: PROPOSED ONLY, not selected or enabled: the two fixed Rango containers as trust anchors; exactly one ENABLED version in each, created inside the bootstrap window, pinned by numeric id before access; identity derived in the signing operation, Frankel collision refused, written once and equal on every later run. Consistency with the completed bootstrap, not cryptographic proof that no other writer acted.
firstUse.recordBasis: Durable first-use record on the original builder (first-use.json): written once by an explicit enrolment run (workflow rango_first_use_enroll=true), atomically and never overwritten; every later run must match its identity fields. Missing, partial or conflicting state refuses.

signing.toolProof: OCT30-INFRA-S017: the four Fold tools come from the same-run proof of the admitted S016 helper (os/signing-bootstrap/profiles.json fold-rango-v1.localProof), never from checked-in installed hashes.

publication.feedBasis: Unbound: automatic Rango OTA discovery is not established by a GitHub tag and no Rango channel routing is configured; the feed line asset needs a selected channel.
publication.notesBasis: Unbound: UPDATE.md for this build must come from an immutable reviewed commit; none names rango 2026103001.
publication.selectionBasis: OCT30-INFRA-S017: signing never publishes. Publication runs only when the workflow input rango_publish is explicitly true (default false), enforced by the job condition and by rango-retained.py publish. feedChannel and notes stay signing prerequisites because they are signed public assets (rango-stable, UPDATE.md) checked by verify_signed; repository, tag and latest are publication-only.

verification.basis: Unbound: the Rango-specific release-pipeline expectations - variant, apps ([[package, versionCode]]), identities.appSignerSha256, host.tools, updater, permissionApex, systemUiTray and the other sections verify_signed reads. Frankel's updater, framework and feed identities are never claimed for Rango; target, identities (OTA/AVB) and publication are never taken from here.
